sections.overall: The inaugural Grand Slam: France shows proved to be a hit overall. The Tuesday edition featured an excellent title match between Will Ospreay and Kazuchika Okada - the best match of the week. Ospreay very nearly gets back #1 for the first time in a year! The crowd was electric for both shows and hopefully, the trip to France will become a regular feature on the calendar, as it has in Australia and Mexico.
sections.mens: Darby Allin vs Kyle Fletcher for the TNT title was a close second-best match of the week. Frantic, physical and exactly what we were hoping for! There were several other singles matches, including Kofi's second in One-on-Ones, in his challenge for the ROH Title against Bandido.
sections.womens: Mercedes Mone vs Queen Aminata delivered and after the crowd warmed up, was thrilling by the end. This was Queen's best singles match to date and, hopefully, not the end of her current push. Also a shoutout to both Willow Nightingale and Marina Shafir who featured in mixed 8 Person Tag on Night 2. They clearly proved how well they can hang with the men!
sections.menstag: The Tag Title match on Night 2 featuring the Young Bucks vs The Dogs (Connors & Finlay) was stronger than the Night 1 bout. It was a low-key first defense for the Bucks, with more on the horizon when they take on Fletcher & Knight at the PPV.
sections.womenstag: A 3 Way Tag for the Number One Contendership was fun, but did not meet anywhere near the two recent Divine Dominion matches. The former champs lose their 'Bronze' status (just under 120 now) but could well regain it on the next Dynamite. The new team of WrathLander have only had one official match, so do not rank in the division, yet.
sections.trios: No straight Trios for the first time in a while. Missing New Level & Strickland? Don't worry, they will be defending at WrestleDream. Their rating of 130+ is the best we've seen for years!
